videos.title: What If Earth Was Actually Flat? (Real Gravity) 🌍
videos.description:
On a flat Earth, gravity would pull toward the middle: walking to the edge feels like climbing a hill, the oceans pile up in the center, and the disk would crush itself into a ball.
Would you live at the center or the edge? 👇
